title: A bill to direct the Administrator of General Services, on behalf of the Archivist of the United States, to convey certain Federal property located in the State of Alaska to the Municipality of Anchorage, Alaska.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was reported to the Senate on March 15, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This bill directs the General Services Administration, on behalf of the Archivist of the United States, to offer to convey to the city of Anchorage, Alaska, for not less than fair market value, a parcel of U.S. property in such city consisting of approximately nine acres and improvements located at 400 East Fortieth Avenue that is administered by the National Archives and Records Administration.

The city shall be responsible for paying the costs of a survey, an appraisal, and any other costs relating to the conveyance of the federal property.

Any net proceeds received by the Archivist as a result of the conveyance shall be deposited in the Treasury and used for deficit reduction.

summary.headline: This law directs the federal government to offer a roughly nine-acre Anchorage, Alaska property held by the National Archives to the city.
summary.what_it_does: The General Services Administration must offer to transfer a parcel of about nine acres with buildings at 400 East Fortieth Avenue in Anchorage to the city. The city must sell it for at least fair market value and pay for the survey, appraisal, and other transfer costs. Any money the federal government receives from the sale goes to the Treasury to reduce the deficit.

who_it_affects.how: The city gets the chance to acquire the federal property but must pay fair market value and cover the survey, appraisal, and other transfer costs.
The agency currently administers the property, and the law sends its sale proceeds to the Treasury rather than back to the agency.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 20, 2016. The official summary does not give a deadline for the offer or the transfer.
